semanticDecisions: budget default Runtime.maxMemory() mirrors MaxDirectMemorySize; 0 admits no multi-unit local atom; negative or unparsable values fall back; read from the saved properties once

bytes are reserved before the native allocation and handed back if the allocation throws; a bucket hit reserves nothing; the single-unit lane (at most 65,536 atoms, 128 KiB) is accounted but never refuses

back-pressure runs outside the bucket lock; the terminal step refuses with null (the String keeps its flat spelling) and never throws; a failed cycle arms a one-second hold-off so sustained pressure costs at most one GC-assisted cycle per second
tuple retention cap counts registered TupleRef entries (live or awaiting expunge) exactly; beyond it the composition is correct but not canonical
a lexicon failure is reported once per VM; the unavailable sentinel is kept so no retry happens per call

String.replace locates the match through the mixed-side search before admitting anything: an absent target keeps the receiver's identity, a flat target never enters the pool, only the replacement is admitted; every refusal falls through to the flat compatibility path with byte-identical results
